name: Conqueror's Haki
description: Haoshoku: the will of a king, given to about one in a few million. It cannot be drilled; it leaps in crises and clashes.

stages.name: Unwilled burst
stages.description: A surge of will that bursts out with no aim.
stages.text: A surge left you, and weak-willed people around you dropped.

stages.name: Willed burst
stages.text: This time you chose to let it out, and the crowd went down.

stages.name: Selective burst
stages.description: Choose who falls and who stands.
stages.text: Your enemies fell and your friends kept their feet.

stages.name: Conqueror's coating
stages.description: Wrap attacks in Conqueror's Haki: they crack the air before they land.
stages.text: Black lightning crackled around your fist before it ever touched.

stages.name: A clash of Conquerors
stages.description: Meet another Conqueror's will, and not give way.
stages.text: Two wills met and the sky split above you.
